surfaceForm: University of Luxembourg / the University (recurring throughout, e.g. "members of the academic community of the University of Luxembourg")
location: ul-it-policy/main/main-body-EN.tex — Sec. 'Summary for stakeholders' (and pervasively in Reading guide, European regulatory context, Examples, Cost, Transition, ICRADP)
proposedGenericDecision: Replace with a role-based placeholder for the adopting institution, e.g. \institution{THE INSTITUTION} / 'the higher-education institution'.
rationale: Named adopting institution is the single most pervasive institution-binding element; every reference must resolve to a configurable institution name for the document to be agnostic.

surfaceForm: Board of Governors (\institution{Board of Governors}); also 'Conseil de Gouvernance'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. 'Summary for stakeholders' (On the nature of this report; Message to the Board); Federated governance / exec-training
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to role 'the institution's supreme governing board' with a configurable label.
rationale: Board of Governors is a UL-specific governance organ name; the role (supreme governing board) is generic but the label varies (council, senate, board of trustees).

surfaceForm: Rectorate; Faculty Council; University Council; Rector
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. 'Summary for stakeholders'; Reading guide; ISO 27001 (president/rector); Exec-training (Rector)
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to role-based governance tiers: 'executive leadership (rectorate/presidency)', 'faculty-level body', 'institution-wide academic body'.
rationale: Rectorate/Faculty Council/University Council/Rector encode a continental-European rectorate governance shape; an agnostic doc must abstract to roles since other systems use President/Provost/Senate/Trustees.

surfaceForm: decision path 'endorsement by the relevant Faculty Council(s), then by the University Council, before operational implementation'; 'three faculties, each with departments...interdisciplinary centres'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. 'Digital Policy Commission' (sec:dpc)
proposedGenericDecision: Abstract to a generic multi-tier endorsement chain (unit body -> institution-wide body -> implementation) without asserting a fixed faculty count or named tiers.
rationale: The 'three faculties + interdisciplinary centres' structure and the specific endorsement chain assume UL's organisational shape; role-based phrasing keeps the mechanism but drops the count and named tiers.

surfaceForm: Department of Computer Science (DCS)
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. NIS2 (notified 3 April 2026); Compliance posture Position D; Cost (pilot); Transition (Step 2 pilot)
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'a computer-science / cybersecurity-competent unit' as candidate pilot host.
rationale: DCS is the specific UL unit that received the ILR notification and hosts the pilot; the role (CS/security-competent department) is generic and should be parameterized.

surfaceForm: SnT — Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Cost (pilot); Transition (Step 2 pilot)
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'an interdisciplinary security/trust research centre' as a candidate pilot entity.
rationale: SnT is a UL-specific named centre; only its role (security-focused interdisciplinary centre) is needed for the pilot argument.

surfaceForm: ULHPC; MeluXina (EuroHPC); 'the university's HPC team'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. 'Luxembourg status' (subsec:lux-sdmz-status); Cost; Transition
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise ULHPC to 'the institution's HPC facility' and MeluXina to 'a national/regional HPC resource'; keep the architectural point.
rationale: ULHPC and MeluXina are Luxembourg-specific named facilities; the SDMZ feasibility argument is generic and only needs the HPC role.

surfaceForm: ILR — Institut Luxembourgeois de Régulation (\gls{ilr})
location: main-body-EN.tex — pervasive: Board message, Reading guide, NIS2 (sec:nis2), Lu landscape, Obligations mapping, Advocacy, Federated governance, Transition, Propositions
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to role 'the national NIS2 supervisory authority' with a configurable name.
rationale: ILR is the Luxembourg NIS2 supervisor; its role (national NIS2 competent authority) is universal under NIS2 but the body name is jurisdiction-specific.

surfaceForm: GOVCERT.LU (\gls{govcertlu})
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Lu landscape (supervisory chain); Shared Security Organizations
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'the governmental CSIRT competent for the public sector'.
rationale: GOVCERT.LU is the LU government CSIRT; the role (public-sector first-line CSIRT) is generic across jurisdictions.

surfaceForm: HCPN — Haut-Commissariat à la Protection nationale (\gls{hcpn})
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Lu landscape; MONARC (Luxembourg House of Cybersecurity context); Shared Security Orgs
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'the national point of contact for cross-border NIS2 cooperation / national protection authority'.
rationale: HCPN is LU-specific; the NIS2 'single point of contact' role is required by the Directive in every member state but the host body differs.

surfaceForm: ANSSI Luxembourg / ANSSI-LU (\gls{anssilu}); PSI-LU (Politique générale de la sécurité de l'information de l'État luxembourgeois)
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Lu landscape (supervisory chain; public-sector reference framework)
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise ANSSI-LU to 'the national information-systems security agency' and PSI-LU to 'the national public-sector information-security baseline'.
rationale: ANSSI-LU and PSI-LU are LU national instruments; the roles (national infosec agency; State infosec policy) are generic. Note the doc itself distinguishes ANSSI-LU from French ANSSI — disambiguation logic also institution/jurisdiction-bound.

surfaceForm: CNPD (\institution{CNPD}) — Luxembourg data protection authority
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Lu landscape (SERIMA partners); AI safeguards (Position D.5); Advocacy positioning
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'the national data protection authority'.
rationale: CNPD is the LU supervisory authority under GDPR; role (national DPA) is universal, name is jurisdiction-specific.

surfaceForm: CIRCL (\gls{circl}); CSSF (\gls{cssf}); Luxembourg House of Cybersecurity; NC3 (National Cybersecurity Competence Center)
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Lu landscape (ecosystem disambiguation); MONARC subsection
proposedGenericDecision: Drop or generalise the LU ecosystem-disambiguation block; if kept, parameterize to generic roles (private-sector CSIRT, financial-sector regulator, national cyber competence centre).
rationale: CIRCL/CSSF/LHC/NC3 are LU-specific bodies introduced only for national-ecosystem disambiguation; an agnostic doc likely drops the disambiguation entirely or replaces with generic roles.

surfaceForm: SERIMA (SEcurity RIsk MAnagement platform), operational since 2 May 2025
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Lu landscape (notification platform); Obligations tables; Regulatory summary; Transition; Propositions
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'the national incident-notification platform'; drop the operational-since date or parameterize.
rationale: SERIMA is the LU single national notification channel; the role (consolidated NIS2/GDPR/CER notification platform) is generic but the platform identity and launch date are LU-specific.

surfaceForm: NCSS III — National Cybersecurity Strategy III (2018), Implementation Objective 7; 'Government Council 26 January 2018'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Lu landscape (national strategy hook); Advocacy (C.4); Reading guide
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'the national cybersecurity strategy's academic-cooperation objective'.
rationale: NCSS III Objective 7 and the dated Government Council approval are LU-specific; the rhetorical hook (national strategy supports academic cooperation) is generic.

surfaceForm: project of law 8364 (PL 8364) — Luxembourg NIS2 transposition; specific articles 2(34°), 2(40°), 11(1)(4°), 11(1)(3°), 12(1), 12(2), 12(3), 11(4)
location: main-body-EN.tex — pervasive: Board message, Reading guide, NIS2, Lu landscape, Obligations mapping, Advocacy (A–D), Propositions, Transition, principlebox
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'the applicable national NIS2 transposition' and abstract article-level pegs to generic NIS2-Directive articles (Art. 21, 23, 20, 32 etc.) or to parameterized national-article placeholders.
rationale: PL 8364 and its specific article numbering are the LU transposition; an agnostic doc must point to 'the national transposition' and map LU article numbers to the underlying NIS2 Directive articles which are common across the EU.

surfaceForm: project of law 8307 (PL 8307) — Luxembourg CER transposition (deposited 1 September 2023)
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Lu landscape (concomitant CER framework); Methodology note
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'the national CER (Critical Entities Resilience) transposition'.
rationale: PL 8307 and its deposit date are LU-specific; the CER Directive 2022/2557 cross-reference is generic EU law.

surfaceForm: Law of 28 November 2006 (LU transposition of Directive 2000/78/EC); Law of 28 November 2006 in national labour law
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. ICRADP (European Equal Treatment and Disability Law)
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'the national transposition of Directive 2000/78/EC into labour law'.
rationale: The 28 November 2006 law is the LU implementation; the EU directive it transposes is generic and can stay, but the national instrument must be parameterized.

surfaceForm: 'classified as an essential entity on the basis of its status as a public institution'; 'confirmed by the ILR in a letter ... notified on 3 April 2026'; three cumulative legal pegs
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Board message; Reading guide; NIS2 (sec:nis2); Lu landscape
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise the classification narrative to a conditional: 'where the institution is classified as an essential (or important) entity under its national NIS2 transposition'; drop the dated notification event.
rationale: The specific essential-entity classification, the dated ILR letter, and the three LU-statute pegs are an institution- and jurisdiction-bound factual claim; an agnostic doc must present classification as a configurable condition, not an asserted fact about UL.

surfaceForm: 'notified on 3 April 2026'; 'operational since 2 May 2025'; 'approved by the Government Council on 13 July 2018 / 26 January 2018'; 'Trusted Introducer member since 2009'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. NIS2; Lu landscape; public-sector framework; Shared Security Orgs (RESTENA-CSIRT)
proposedGenericDecision: Drop institution/jurisdiction-specific dated events or replace with neutral phrasing.
rationale: These precise dates anchor LU national events and the UL notification; they have no role in an institution-agnostic template and should be removed.

surfaceForm: RESTENA (\gls{restena}) — Luxembourg NREN; RESTENA-CSIRT
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Reading guide; Examples (panel rationale); Lu status (SDMZ); NREN section; Shared Security Orgs; Propositions (federated identity)
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'the national research-and-education network (NREN)' and 'the NREN CSIRT', keeping GÉANT as the generic European backbone.
rationale: RESTENA is the LU NREN; the NREN role is generic (every country has one) so it should be a localization variable while the GÉANT/eduroam/eduGAIN backbone primitives remain.

surfaceForm: 'at the Luxembourg scale'; 'equivalent primitives at the Luxembourg scale'; 'too small for three separate Science DMZs'; 'EPFL (~12,000 students, comparable to the University of Luxembourg)'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Reading guide (academic domain); Examples (size-comparable panel); Lu status (mutualised SDMZ)
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise scale references to 'the institution's scale' / 'a small national research ecosystem'; drop the EPFL-size comparison anchor or parameterize the comparator.
rationale: The 'Luxembourg scale' and the ~12,000-student size anchor bind the document to UL's specific size and to a small-country ecosystem; the agnostic version must abstract scale to a configurable descriptor.

surfaceForm: LIST (Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology); LIH (Luxembourg Institute of Health)
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Lu status (mutualised, not siloed; reframing question)
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'other research-active institutions in the national ecosystem'.
rationale: LIST and LIH are LU national research institutes named as co-consumers of a federated SDMZ; only the role (peer research institutions) is needed for the federation argument.

surfaceForm: 'Under the Luxembourg transposition of the NIS2 Directive'; 'binding nationally under Article 12(1) of the Luxembourg transposition'; 'Prior practice in the Luxembourg public sector'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Board message; NIS2; principlebox (seven zones); Advocacy B.3
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'under the applicable national NIS2 transposition'; abstract 'Luxembourg public sector' precedent claims to 'the relevant national public sector'.
rationale: Numerous sentences assume the LU transposition and LU public-sector practice as the binding national layer; an agnostic doc keeps the EU-Directive layer and parameterizes the national transposition reference.

surfaceForm: MONARC (\gls{monarc}) — described as developed by NC3 under the Luxembourg House of Cybersecurity; 'Luxembourg-developed methodology'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Normative frameworks (MONARC subsection); Architectural proposition; Propositions P14; Transition
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'an ISO/IEC 27005-aligned open-source risk-analysis method/tool' with the LU-origin framing dropped; ISO/IEC 27005 remains as the generic anchor.
rationale: MONARC is usable internationally but the doc frames it as a LU-developed, LU-politically-relevant, SERIMA-integrated tool; the agnostic version keeps the ISO 27005 role and parameterizes/de-emphasizes the LU-specific tool and its national integration.

surfaceForm: Université Paris-Saclay (Aug 2024, RansomHouse, ANSSI); Université de Rennes (Mar 2025, ISTIC, FunkSec); Sorbonne Université; Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center; Western Sydney University; Howard University; University of Phoenix; Harvard (1.3 TB); Dartmouth; UPenn; Baker University
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. 'Media-Covered Failures' (sec:defaillances-mediatiques); Board/CISO/Central-IT messages reference Paris-Saclay/Western Sydney/Texas Tech
proposedGenericDecision: Keep as external evidence (these are third-party incidents, not the adopting institution) but verify framing stays generic; they are not institution-binding to the adopting university. Keep.
rationale: Named incidents are at OTHER institutions and serve as evidence layer; they do not bind the document to UL. They remain valid in an agnostic template, though the cross-references in stakeholder messages that pair them with UL framing should be checked. Flagged for completeness.

surfaceForm: 'the French national cybersecurity agency (ANSSI)' (Paris-Saclay recovery); RENATER (French NREN); 'French equivalent of the Luxembourg framework'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Media-Covered Failures (Paris-Saclay); Examples (Paris-Saclay panel rationale, French universities); NREN section
proposedGenericDecision: Keep ANSSI/RENATER as factual attributes of the cited external French cases; but rephrase 'French equivalent of the Luxembourg framework' to 'the applicable national framework' since it presumes the LU baseline as the reference point.
rationale: ANSSI/RENATER are correct as facts about external cases (keep), but the comparative phrase 'French equivalent of the Luxembourg framework' anchors the comparison to LU and must be generalized.

surfaceForm: 'sanctions up to EUR 10 M or 2 % of annual turnover'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Reading guide (NIS2 description, European regulatory landscape)
proposedGenericDecision: Keep as a generic NIS2-Directive figure (the 10M EUR / 2% ceiling is set by the Directive itself, not LU-specific). Keep, but confirm it is cited as the Directive ceiling rather than a national amount.
rationale: The EUR 10M / 2% figure is the NIS2 Directive's essential-entity ceiling and is common across the EU, so it is not institution-binding; retained but flagged because the prompt lists EUR amounts as candidate items.

surfaceForm: \institution{Institut Luxembourgeois de Régulation} (\gls{ilr}); \gls expansions GOVCERT.LU, HCPN, ANSSI-LU, PSI-LU, SERIMA, RESTENA, CNPD, CIRCL, CSSF, MONARC, ICRADP, CARPN
location: main-body-EN.tex — glossary-backed acronyms used throughout (the .tex relies on \gls / \institution macros that expand to UL/LU terms)
proposedGenericDecision: Audit the glossary/acronym source so that LU-specific \gls entries are repointed to generic role labels or made localization variables; \institution{} calls naming LU bodies must resolve to parameterized names.
rationale: Many institution-bound terms are injected via \gls / \institution macros; making the document agnostic requires the macro expansions (defined outside this body file) to be neutralized/parameterized, not just the inline prose.

surfaceForm: 'on campus', 'campus backbone', 'campus network core', 'campus perimeter', 'on-campus and remote learners', 'Science DMZ ... built at the campus perimeter'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Staff/BYOD message; Science DMZ (subsec); Conceptual architecture; Segmented network figure
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise 'campus' to 'site(s)/institutional network perimeter' to avoid presuming a single-campus topology; keep where 'campus' is a generic Science-DMZ term of art but flag multi-campus institutions.
rationale: Repeated 'campus' phrasing softly assumes a single-campus/single-perimeter institution; multi-site institutions need neutral 'site/perimeter' wording, though 'campus' is partly a standard term in the Science-DMZ literature.

surfaceForm: 'In a country that is among the wealthiest in the world, and whose governance bodies set excellence as the sole objective'; 'implementable within the university's multi-year agreement with the State'; 'typical university budgets'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Justification and Feasibility (sec:couts); Conclusion
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to neutral feasibility framing ('within the institution's multi-year planning / funding agreement'); drop the wealth-of-the-country claim.
rationale: The 'wealthiest country' and 'multi-year agreement with the State' phrasing binds the cost argument to Luxembourg's funding context; an agnostic version uses jurisdiction-neutral budgeting language.

surfaceForm: 'The University of Luxembourg has more than two decades of experience adapting external models to its specific public-research context.'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Examples (Relevant and Adequate Reference panel, criterion 4 Track record)
proposedGenericDecision: Drop the self-referential track-record claim or generalise to 'the institution's track record of adapting external models'.
rationale: A self-referential UL experience claim is institution-binding and not portable; either drop or make it a configurable statement about the adopting institution.

surfaceForm: 'The precedent of the University of Luxembourg: the Committee for Reasonable Adjustments' (existing UL committee for students/staff with disabilities)
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. ICRADP (subsection 'The precedent of the University of Luxembourg')
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'where the institution already operates a reasonable-adjustments committee for disability/specific needs' as a conditional precedent.
rationale: This whole subsection rests on an existing UL committee; the coherence argument ('already adjusts academic practices, so extend to digital') is generic but the named precedent is UL-specific and must become conditional.

surfaceForm: ICRADP / 'fr: CARPN' (French acronym for the proposed Independent Commission)
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. ICRADP title (sec:commission-ajustements proposal heading)
proposedGenericDecision: Drop the French CARPN gloss (jurisdiction/language-bound) or parameterize the local-language acronym.
rationale: 'fr: CARPN' presumes a French-speaking jurisdiction; the English ICRADP is generic but the local-language acronym should be a localization variable.

surfaceForm: 'research-only units, research-and-teaching departments, and teaching/training-only components' described as 'organisationally distinct entities' 'At the University of Luxembourg'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Introduction (Context); Specificities note (tab:besoins note); Propositions P8; ICRADP mission
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to a role-based mission typology (research / teaching / administration) without asserting the specific UL tri-partite unit taxonomy as a fact about the institution.
rationale: The explicit 'At the University of Luxembourg, these missions are carried out by organisationally distinct entities: ...' encodes UL's specific organisational model; the mission split is generic but the asserted unit taxonomy should be abstracted.

surfaceForm: 'universities receiving sensitive funding (notably US DoD)'; 'DoD-funded FFRDC'; CUI/HIPAA/FISMA/ITAR references as the operative compliance drivers
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. State of the art (NIST SP 800-171, secure enclaves); Examples (MIT ITAR/HIPAA, CMU SEI, Michigan CUI)
proposedGenericDecision: Keep US-funding references where they describe external precedent institutions; but where 800-171/CUI is presented as a driver, frame as 'where the institution processes regulated data (e.g. controlled, health, classified)'.
rationale: US DoD/CUI/FISMA drivers are jurisdiction-specific; for external precedents they are factual (keep), but as a generic driver for the adopting institution they should be abstracted to 'applicable regulated-data regime'.

surfaceForm: '\gls{nis2} essential-entity regime' applied to 'the University' as a settled status; principlebox 'applicable to the University as an essential entity'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Summary for stakeholders (opening); principlebox (seven zones); Propositions P14
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise opening framing from 'the University [is] an essential entity' to 'institutions under the NIS2 essential-entity (or important-entity) regime', making classification a configurable premise.
rationale: The document repeatedly treats essential-entity status as an established fact about the adopting institution; an agnostic template must state it as a conditional regime the institution may fall under.
